task: wearable daily aggregates feature extraction and trend analysis

tests_run.description: Python bytecode compilation across modified and created modules.
24 focused tests verifying daily steps, resting heart rate, sleep duration, Theil-Sen slope, source-switch critic, non-diagnostic disclaimers, and FastAPI endpoint feature gates.
54 combined regression and domain tests verifying longitudinal and wearable signal processing.
Path ACL checker verifying strict isolation to A04 lane.

daily_aggregates_engine.finding: Implemented deterministic daily aggregations in services/ml/src/clara_ml/wearables/aggregates.py supporting steps (deduplication, interval summing, daily ceiling), resting heart rate (robust median, MAD, bounds filtering), and sleep duration (overnight wake-up date attribution, stage accumulation, interval consolidation) without any mock data.

trend_detection_engine.finding: Implemented robust trend detection and source-shift critic in services/ml/src/clara_ml/wearables/trend_detection.py utilizing Theil-Sen slope estimator, personal baseline MAD scaling, source-switch transition detector, and Decision Ledger audit logging.

safety_invariants.finding: Enforced non-diagnostic disclaimers (vi/en), corroboration requirement for clinical actions, quarantine of physiologically implausible or extreme values, and gated by WEARABLE_AGGREGATES_ENABLED feature flag.
